title: Spooky Jam 2026 Games Showcase
description:
We will demo all of the entries to the jam at Maryville University in the Design & Visual Art Building Rm 103. Come show off your entry and check out what others made!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/316806627
location: Maryville University, 650 Maryville University Dr, St. Louis, MO 63141, USA

title: SLICExpo 2026
description: The St. Louis Independent Comics Expo (SLICE) is St. Louis’s premier annual indie-print showcase, bringing together over 100 writers and artists from St. Louis and beyond to showcase their self-published books, comics, zines, prints, magazines, poetry, and more. SLICE 2026 takes place on October 31, 10 a.m.–5 p.m., at The Sheldon Concert Hall and Art Galleries. The expo is free to attend and open to the public. Programming throughout the day will include lectures and workshops by SLICE’s special and featured guests, as well as activities provided by local artists and organizations.
location: The Sheldon Concert Hall and Art Galleries, 3648 Washington Ave, St. Louis, MO 63108, USA

title: Cougar Jam 2026 (SIUE)
description: Cougar Jam is the SIUE Game Development Group's annual game jam! Teams have three days to make a game complete for scratch! It is a weekend event with special guest judges, free food, and prizes! Open to any college student!
location: SIUE School of Engineering, 62026, 61 Circle Dr, Edwardsville, IL 62026, USA

title: STLVGMO Trivia Night Fundraiser
description:

$25 / person or $200 / 8-person table GET TICKETS

title: November Game Audio Club
description:
If you’re into making video game music or sound design (or just curious) come hang out with us once a month! Doesn’t matter if you’re a pro or just starting out— everyone’s welcome. Just bring your love for game audio. Chill time where you can share your work, get feedback, or just vibe with people who love game audio.
